name: FeedbackGate
summary: Review-request software that sends automated email and SMS asks, routes ratings and alerts on negative feedback; plans by contacts and message volume, with white-label for agencies.
best_for: small local businesses that want automated email and SMS review requests with alerts on negative feedback, and that will offer every customer the public review link
skip_if: you want to use the rating gate to keep unhappy customers off Google, you need published overage rates, or you want a vendor whose terms name the company and a refund policy you can read
honest_knock: The headline feature is a rating gate that sends happy customers to Google and unhappy ones to a private form, and Google's Business Profile policy forbids exactly that: merchants may not selectively solicit positive reviews (read 14 October 2026). Used as designed, it can cost you the reviews it collected. The site contradicts itself on whether the trial needs a credit card, overage rates are not published, and the terms point to a refund policy we could not find and do not name the company behind the service. Usage claims and the competitor comparison table are the vendor's own. We have not used FeedbackGate ourselves.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · per month for up to 500 contacts, 1,000 emails and 100 SMS a month
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-14 in a live browser on feedbackgate.com/pricing, the home page, the about page and the terms of service dated 1 January 2025) Three monthly plans, each with a 14-day free trial. Starter is $69 a month: up to 500 contacts, 1,000 emails and 100 SMS a month, basic analytics, the rating gate and email support. Growth is $149 a month: up to 2,500 contacts, 5,000 emails and 500 SMS, advanced analytics and reports, the rating gate with custom routing, campaign automation, brand customization, team management, priority email and chat support, Zapier and API access. Agency is $399 a month: up to 10,000 contacts, 20,000 emails and 2,000 SMS, full white-label branding, custom domain support, custom integrations and a dedicated account manager. Every plan has pay-as-you-go overages, but no overage rate is published; the FAQ says you upgrade or buy additional message credits. Annual billing saves 20% according to the FAQ, through the sales team. No setup fees. Payments are processed by Lemon Squeezy. The pricing page says the trial needs no credit card; the home page says a credit card is required for the trial.

compare_with.name: NiceJob
compare_with.why: NiceJob is in our dossiers too, read on 13 October 2026: Starter $75 a month and Pro $125 a month for automated review requests and social proof. FeedbackGate, read on 14 October 2026, starts at $69 a month for 500 contacts and 100 SMS, with Growth at $149. They are close on price; the difference to weigh is that FeedbackGate is built around a rating gate that Google's policy on selectively soliciting positive reviews rules out as a filter, so compare how each lets you ask every customer.
